# Error codes

Every machine-readable reason obbyx returns, why it happens and what to do.
`settlement_pending` and the `*_ledger_unavailable` reasons mean "outcome unknown yet":
repeat the same request later; it never pays twice.

## Common (any scheme)

Returned by /verify (`invalidReason`) and /settle (`errorReason`) for any scheme.

| Code | Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `settlement_pending` | The payment is valid and in progress but not final yet (exact: waiting for stability; batch: waiting for the seller watcher). | Repeat the same request later; it never pays twice. `transaction` holds the unit hash / commitment id to track. |
| `invalid_payment_requirements` | The requirements are malformed, or `accepted` in the payload differs from what the seller asked for. | Seller: check the offer (amount, asset, payTo, extra). Client: pay the offer exactly as received. |
| `invalid_network` | Network is not an Obyte network served here, or the payload and the requirements name different networks. | Use a network listed in GET /supported. |
| `unsupported_scheme` | The scheme/network pair is not registered on this facilitator. | Use a kind listed in GET /supported. |
| `invalid_x402_version` | x402Version is not supported for this request (v1 is accepted for exact only). | Use x402 v2 (v1 only for exact). |
| `invalid_payload` | The payment payload has the wrong shape for its scheme. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `missing_parameters` | The request body lacks paymentPayload or paymentRequirements. | Send `{x402Version, paymentPayload, paymentRequirements}`. |
| `invalid_json` | The request body is not valid JSON. | Send `content-type: application/json` with a JSON body. |
| `unexpected_verify_error` | Internal error during /verify (logged with the request id). | Retry; if it repeats, the operator checks the facilitator logs. |
| `unexpected_settle_error` | Internal error during /settle (logged with the request id). | Repeat the same request later; it never pays twice. |
| `unauthorized` | FACILITATOR_API_KEYS is set and the request has no valid key (HTTP 401). | Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (HTTPFacilitatorClient `createAuthHeaders`). |
| `rate_limited` | More than RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE requests from this key or IP (HTTP 429). | Slow down; the operator can raise the limit. |
| `package_corrupt` | A stored channel package cannot be decrypted (wrong PACKAGE_KEY_FILE or a tampered row); the operation fails closed. | Operator: restore the original key file. Never replace it while channel payments are pending. |
| `package_not_encrypted` | A stored channel package is not encrypted (database written by an older build). | Operator: let pending channel payments finish on the old build, then start the new one on a fresh database. |

## exact

The client signs a complete Obyte unit; the facilitator checks it and broadcasts it.

| Code | Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_unsupported_unit` | The unit has fields, messages or authors outside the supported profile (one author, payment + data messages). | Compose the payment with ExactObyteClient. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_unit_too_large` | The unit exceeds the size limit. | Use fewer inputs (consolidate coins). |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_network` | The unit version/alt does not belong to the requested network (e.g. a livenet unit on testnet). | Sign the unit for the network of the offer. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_unit_hash` | The unit hash does not match its content. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_payload_hash` | A message payload hash does not match the payload. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_definition` | The address definition does not match the author address. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_definition_required` | The address is not known on the ledger yet and the unit does not include its definition. | Include the definition in the first unit from a new address (ExactObyteClient does this). |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_signature` | The author signature is invalid. | Check the wallet key; re-sign. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_commissions` | Header/payload commissions do not match the unit size. | Recompose the unit with current parent/witness data. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_recipient_mismatch` | No output pays exactly `payTo`. | Pay the seller address of the offer. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_amount_mismatch` | The amount paid to `payTo` differs from the offer. | Pay exactly `amount`. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_asset_mismatch` | The unit pays a different asset than the offer (or an asset not allowed here). | Pay the `asset` of the offer. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_binding_mismatch` | The data message does not carry the binding/quoteId of the offer. | Pay the current offer; a payment for one request cannot pay for another. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_payer` | The payer equals payTo, or is one of the facilitator operator addresses. | Pay from your own wallet. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_payto_is_aa` | payTo is an autonomous agent: a payment to it triggers the AA, which may bounce the funds back to the payer. | Seller: use a plain address as payTo. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_inputs` | An input does not exist, is not an output of the payer, or has the wrong asset/amount. | Refresh the wallet coins and recompose. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_stale` | The unit timestamp is outside maxTimeoutSeconds (+ clock skew), or its last ball is older than MAX_LAST_BALL_AGE_SECONDS (the network stable point lags). | Compose a fresh unit and check the client clock; for a lagging network see the operations guide (slow stabilization). |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_quote_expired` | The offer `validUntil` has passed. | Request a new offer (repeat the request without payment). |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_publication_window_expired` | The verified unit was not settled within PUBLISH_WINDOW_SECONDS. | Pay again with a fresh offer. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_rejected_by_network` | The hub rejected the unit (e.g. inputs already spent). | Recompose with unspent coins. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_double_spend` | The unit became final-bad (non-serial): the payer double-spent. | The payment is void; do not serve. |
| `invalid_exact_obyte_ledger_unavailable` | The hub did not answer in time while checking the unit; the outcome is unknown. | Repeat the same request later; it never pays twice. |

## batch-settlement (payment channels)

The client signs an off-chain voucher for an Obyte AA channel; the seller watcher stores it before the facilitator confirms.

| Code | Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_payload` | The voucher or channel fields are malformed. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_voucher_signature` | The voucher signature does not verify for the channel client address. | Sign with the wallet that opened the channel. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_channel_not_found` | The channel AA does not exist on the ledger (or its definition is not stable yet). | Wait until the open/deposit unit is stable, then retry. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_channel_params` | The channel parameters do not name this seller/client/asset. | Open a channel to the seller of the offer. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_channel_timeout` | The channel dispute window is shorter than the seller minimum (`minTimeout`). | Open a channel with --window ≥ minTimeout. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_period_mismatch` | The voucher period differs from the current channel period. | Resync the channel state (`obbyx channel status`). |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_channel_closing` | The channel is closing; it cannot accept new payments. | Wait for the close to finish and open a new channel. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_cumulative_exceeds_balance` | The cumulative amount exceeds the channel deposit. | Top up: `obbyx channel deposit`. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_cumulative_amount_mismatch` | The cumulative amount is not previous + price. | Resync the channel state; the client store is behind or ahead. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_payment_amount_mismatch` | The voucher increment differs from the offer amount. | Pay exactly `amount`. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_binding_mismatch` | The voucher does not carry the binding of the offer. | Pay the current offer. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_asset` | The channel asset is not accepted here. | Use a channel in an allowed asset. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_channel_busy` | Another voucher of this channel is in flight (one at a time per channel). | Retry after the previous payment completes. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_watcher_unavailable` | The seller watcher is offline, its heartbeat is stale, or it is underfunded. | Seller: start the watcher and fund it (WATCHER_MIN_BYTES). |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_voucher_refused` | The seller's watcher signed a refusal (nack) of this voucher: it is cancelled, not charged, and the channel is free again. | Client: pay again (a new voucher). Seller: check the watcher log for the reason. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_ledger_unavailable` | The hub did not answer while reading the channel; the outcome is unknown. | Repeat the same request later; it never pays twice. |
| `invalid_batch_settlement_obyte_quote_expired` | The offer `validUntil` has passed. | Request a new offer. |

## Signed packages and channel definitions

Low-level validation reasons, surfaced inside the messages of the scheme errors above.

| Code | Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_signed_package` | The signed package has the wrong shape or extra fields. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `invalid_signed_package_definition` | The package definition does not match the signer address. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `invalid_signed_package_signature` | The package signature is invalid. | Re-sign with the right key. |
| `invalid_signed_package_signer` | The package is signed by an unexpected address. | Sign with the channel client wallet. |
| `invalid_signed_package_network` | The package was signed for another network. | Sign for the network of the offer. |
| `invalid_channel_params` | The channel AA parameters are malformed. | Use a channel created by obbyx (base AA v1.2). |
| `invalid_channel_definition` | The address is not a channel of the supported base AA. | Use a channel of the supported base AA. |

## Seller (ObytePaywall / ExactObyteServer)

HTTP errors the paid API returns to the client (JSON `{"error": code}` or a 402 with the reason).

| Code | Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_payment_header` | The PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header is not valid base64 JSON. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `invalid_binding` | The payment was made for another request (method, URL, body or price differ). | Pay the offer of THIS request. |
| `invalid_payment_reused` | This proof was already used with a different binding. | Do not reuse payments across requests. |
| `payment_already_used` | This proof already served a request (official middleware path). | Pay again; one payment serves one operation. |
| `payment_in_progress` | The same payment (or payment-identifier) is being served right now. | Wait and repeat the same request. |
| `payment_failed` | The payment definitely failed earlier (e.g. rejected or double-spent). | Pay again with a fresh offer. |
| `quote_expired` | The offer expired before the payment arrived. | Repeat the request without payment to get a new offer. |
| `invalid_payment` | The facilitator rejected the payment (the 402 carries its reason). | See the facilitator reason in the 402 body. |
| `facilitator_unavailable` | The facilitator did not answer. | Retry later (seller: check FACILITATOR_URL and its /health). |
| `missing_stored_response` | The proof is marked served but its stored response is missing (store damaged). | Seller: check the proofs database; the client should contact the seller. |
| `payment_identifier_required` | The seller requires the payment-identifier extension and none was sent. | Send a payment id (payingFetch does this automatically). |
| `invalid_payment_identifier` | The payment id is not 16–128 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. | Use a valid id. |
| `payment_identifier_conflict` | The payment id was already used for a different operation. | Use a new id for a new operation. |
| `invalid_price` | The route price is not `{asset, amount}` or `"<n> bytes"` / `"<x> GBYTE"`. | Seller: fix the route configuration. |

## Client (SDK and CLI)

Thrown as `ObbyxError` with this `code`.

| Code | Cause | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `payment_pending` | The payment was made but is not final within the wait time. | Retry later with the same payment (`obbyx pay … --payment <header>`). |
| `invalid_402` | The server answered 402 without a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. | The server is not an x402 server. |
| `invalid_amount` | An amount is not a valid non-negative number in the expected precision. | Check --max/--deposit values (GBYTE, up to 9 decimals). |
| `ledger_unavailable` | The hub did not answer. | Retry; check --hub. |
| `invalid_config` | An environment variable is invalid (all problems are listed). | Fix the listed variables (see the configuration reference). |
| `invalid_key` | Internal: a storage key was built from empty parts. | Client or SDK bug: report it with the request id from the logs. |
| `channel_closing` | The channel is being closed (on-chain, or by our own close that is not on-chain yet). No voucher is signed until a later period starts. | Wait for the close to finish (`obbyx channel status`), then deposit again for a new period. |
| `max_signed_uncertain` | The highest voucher signed in the period being closed is not known for sure (a channel database migrated from an old version, or a recovered channel). Declaring too little lets the seller take the whole deposit with a fraud proof. | `obbyx channel close <aa> --declare <the highest amount you may have signed>`, or `--force` to declare only what is known. |
| `declare_too_low` | The declared amount is below what is known to be signed, or below a close already sent. | Declare at least the amount shown in the error. |
| `close_superseded` | Another process changed the declaration of this close before it was sent; nothing was sent. | Run `obbyx channel status`, then close again if needed (the declaration never goes down). |
| `legacy_channel` | The channel is on the retired base AA v1.1: it can only be closed. | Close it (`obbyx channel close`) and open a new channel. |
| `no_spending_limit` | The batch client has no `maxAmount` for this asset, so it refuses to sign. | Set `maxAmount` for the asset in the client options. |
| `store_too_new` | The channel database was written by a newer obbyx version. | Upgrade obbyx; never run an older version on this database. |
